proof_body:
by
  intro T hT h
  by_contra hlt
  have hlt' : T < 2 * Real.pi := not_le.mp hlt
  have h1 := h (Real.pi / 2)
  have h2 : Real.sin (Real.pi / 2 + T) = Real.cos T := by
    rw [add_comm, Real.sin_add_pi_div_two]
  rw [h2, Real.sin_pi_div_two] at h1
  have hneg : -(2 * Real.pi) < T := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff_of_lt_of_lt hneg hlt').mp h1
  linarith
target_source: ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → (∀ x : ℝ, Real.sin (x + T) = Real.sin x) → 2 * Real.pi ≤ T
